question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias, and should it cover only the inbound-shaped helper set in this PR or the broader historical `turn` helper names?
rationale: The code change is small and technically sound, but it reopens a public plugin runtime contract that root and scoped policy treat as compatibility-sensitive; automation should not decide the deprecation window or helper-name scope.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias
options.body: Refresh the branch and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias for the four inbound-shaped helpers, with `inbound` remaining canonical for new code.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Scope
options.body: Require the PR to restore or document the old `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, `runPrepared`, and `dispatchAssembled` names before merge.

options.title: Reject Core Shim
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide old channel plugins must update to `channel.inbound.*` instead of re-expanding the core runtime surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Alias
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias for the four inbound-shaped helpers, with `inbound` remaining canonical for new code.

likelyOwner.reason: The removal commit for the legacy runtime alias is under this handle/name, making this the best available owner for the compatibility-scope decision.
